note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD 635aa08b78 (independent judge, clean clone). Section 5.2 step 3b: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." Same producer walk as RFC4301-5.2-1. dc7de8e76f and 000e6fdfea changed the two cited units releaseSPD and warnSPDLeft, and nothing else this verdict cites. releaseSPD's only change is the call warnSPDLeft(log) becoming warnSPDLeft(dp, log). warnSPDLeft now names each leftover through spdLeft.describe(dp), which copies the ledger out under l.mu and asks policyDeleteCommand (inner_selectors.go) for each entry's removal command: dataplane.XFRMPolicyDeleteCommand for xfrmBackend, the recorded spdEntries entry for vppBackend (vppPolicyDelCommand), and a plain text naming the selector when the backend names none or a nil dataplane is passed. policyDeleteCommand always returns a string, so describe still returns exactly one name per ledger entry, and warnSPDLeft still returns true exactly when the ledger holds an entry: the decision to keep the catch-all is unchanged, only the text of the warning is. Probe in the clone (go -overlay, tree untouched): warnSPDLeft made to return false always, and describe made to return no name, each turn TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestChildInstallRollbackFailureIsRecordedInTheSPDLedger, TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheExactRemovalCommand and TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheBackendCommand red. vppPolicyInterface and defaultDataplaneSource are byte-identical, so on VPP (no catch-all, `unmatched bypass` only) and under the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries (no catch-all) traffic matching no entry is still delivered, not discarded. Gap stands; {gap} annotation accurate.
